Visa Interview Experience
Tejas Thorat IT BTech 2020-2024
Overview :
This was the first time Visa Inc was visiting our campus and it
was a great experience interviewing for Visa.
I didn’t have any college archives for preparation for the
interview but GFg was the saviour because I found some
experiences over there.
Process :
●They had 2 rounds for the selection process of interns ( 1
online assessment and 1 technical interview).
●Online assessment : Consisting of two coding questions
based only on DSA ( no SQL or any other core questions).
You can skip to the online assessment section of this doc
to know more about questions.
●Technical Interview : Technical Interview was for 1  hr and
was conducted on MS Teams.
Well the questions asked to me during interview were not that
tough but you should prepare DSA thoroughly because
according to some experiences I read before my interview ,
they were asked not only DSA but some topics related to
competitive programming ( E.g Fermats’ Little Theorem)

Online Assessment :
It consisted of 2 coding questions based on DSA and was
conducted on hackerrank platform.
Question 1 : Given two Arrays A,B. Find the number of pairs
<p1,p2> such that p1 is in A , p2 is in B and p1<p2.
Solution : We can solve this question by simply sorting both the
arrays and using two indexes one for each array and sum the
indexes after. Time Complexity (O(n))
(Well the question was not exactly the same and was not this
straightforward but this was the simplest form we can represent
the question).
[All test cases passed]
Question 2 : This question was a little ambiguous or I thought it
was confusing but I had almost 30-35 mins to solve it so I
started working on test cases directly without reading the entire
problem and I figured I would have to use a priority queue to
find the largest element in (log(n)) time.
(I don’t really remember the question but its description wasn’t
helpful in solving, but its was leetcode medium level question)
I solved it in 20 mins and submitted the solutions with 12 mins
remaining.
[All test cases passed]
(It’s okay if you don’t understand the question at first glance
you could directly look at test cases and figure out the solution
or possible approach)

MS Teams Interview :
My interview was scheduled from 12 to 1pm and it was
conducted on MS Teams platform. We were also provided with
a hackerrank CodePair link that was shared between me and
the interviewer.
[Prepare for HR Questions well because these will play an
important role in your selection process]
Question 1 : Tell me about yourself
Ans : Keep Calm and I started describing myself.(I just
answered with the answers I had prepared before the interview
for standard questions.
Question 2 : Tell me about your major project and any
challenges that you faced while building the project.
Ans : For this question I took the experience from SIH
Hackathon and explained about the challenges I faced.
(Prefer taking experience from the projects you have on your
resume)
Question 3 : Do you know about OOPS and which
programming language you usually use and why?
Ans : Yes and I use C++ for programming because I also do
competitive programming and C++ is better suitable for it.
Next was follow up question on OOPS

Question 4 : Explain major pillars on OOPS with an example
Ans : I used the example of a car to explain concepts of
encapsulation, abstraction , etc.
Then she asked me to open the codepair link.
Question 5 : How will you swap two numbers without using a
third variable?
Ans : I knew three approaches with their drawbacks.
1] Using swap function in C++ STL.
2] Storing addition and subtractions of numbers
a=2,b=3
a = a+b=5;
b= a-b =5-3=2 ;
a = a-b = 5-2 = 3;
3] Using XOR (best solution because it avoids overflow)
a = a^b;
b = a^b;
a = a^b;
I answered with the first two and the interviewer didn’t ask
about overflow so I didn’t answer the third but sometimes
interviewers ask about overflows and best methods.
Question 6 : Print the fibonacci numbers in reverse order

Ans : I used a bottom up approach to get fibonacci numbers
and then reverse the array and print it.
She asked if I am familiar with UNIX commands.Which I
answered yes
Question 7 : Which command will you use to copy lines from
line no 10 to line no 15 from a text file to another.
Ans : Well , I didn’t know the answer so I thought on it for
sometime and said that I was only familiar with basic file
commands and networking commands.
The correct answer was
https://stackoverflow.com/questions/47298469/how-to-copy-line
s-10-to-15-of-a-file-into-another-file-in-unix
Question 8 : Explain the difference between full outer join and
inner join with example
Ans : I answered with definitions of both and a basic example.
Then the interviewer started with HR questions
1] If you get a job at Visa but you have to work on a basic java
project for 10 years will you work there ?
Ans : This was a question I was not prepared for but I
answered it as , ‘I will see it as an opportunity and initially I will
work on it and then try to move up the ranks’.
Then she focused that its permanent for 10 years duration.
Here I hesitated to answer so she moved onto next question.

2] What technologies are you interested in?
Ans : I said I was interested in Machine Learning. Then she
started asking why ML and any other technologies. We talked
about it for a bit with the interviewer and shared some of her
experiences with students only focusing on AI/ML and ignoring
other fields.
(I personally thought it was HR question because the
interviewer judged my interests and judged how I handle
constructive criticism)
Then she said about winding up so I asked some questions
about Visa and its working, on which we talked for about 7
minutes and the interview was over.
My interview lasted for almost 40 minutes which is less
compared to some of my other friends whose lasted for more
than 60 minutes.
The shortlist came the same day at night and 4 students were
selected and I was one of them.
